title: TV Series Based on Hypertext Fictions
synopsis: TV series based on hypertext fiction are becoming increasingly popular, but what about the quality?

fullText.simplified:
网络小说改编电视剧

    随着网络文学的不断发展，取材于网络小说的电视剧也越来越多。尤其是近两年，热门电视剧几乎都是由网络小说改编而来。比如今年大热的《青云志》和《微微一笑很倾城》等。这些改编剧拥有庞大的粉丝群体，主演往往是当红影视明星，其商业价值不容小觑。
    然而，这些改编剧的质量参差不齐，观众对其评价也是褒贬不一。究其原因，一个可能是网络小说的改编难度较大。有的小说篇幅动辄上百万字，且往往结构繁复、线索庞杂，而有的小说则是篇幅短小、情节薄弱、人物空洞单薄。另一个原因是有的制作公司太过急功近利，不注重剧本的质量。再好的原著，再红的明星也拯救不了粗制滥造的电视剧。
fullText.traditional:
網絡小說改編電視劇

    隨著網絡文學的不斷發展，取材於網絡小說的電視劇也越來越多。尤其是近兩年，熱門電視劇幾乎都是由網絡小說改編而來。比如今年大熱的《青雲志》和《微微一笑很傾城》等。這些改編劇擁有龐大的粉絲群體，主演往往是當紅影視明星，其商業價值不容小覷。
    然而，這些改編劇的質量參差不齊，觀眾對其評價也是褒貶不一。究其原因，一個可能是網絡小說的改編難度較大。有的小說篇幅動輒上百萬字，且往往結構繁複、線索龐雜，而有的小說則是篇幅短小、情節薄弱、人物空洞單薄。另一個原因是有的製作公司太過急功近利，不注重劇本的質量。再好的原著，再紅的明星也拯救不了粗製濫造的電視劇。

raw.synopsis: TV series based on hypertext fiction are becoming increasingly popular, but what about the quality?
sentence_translations: TV Series Based on Hypertext Fictions
With the development of electronic literature, more and more TV series are based on hypertext fictions.
Especially in the last two years, almost all of the popular TV series were adapted from hypertext fictions.
“Noble Aspirations” and “Just One Smile is Very Alluring” are two examples of TV series being very popular this year.
Nowadays TV series based on hypertext fiction have a huge number of fans and the leading roles are often played by popular stars.
The commercial value of these series should thus not be underestimated.
However, the quality of hypertext fiction based TV series varies and they also received mixed reviews from the audiences.
One reason might be the difficulty in adapting the scripts of hypertext fictions to the TV format.
Some novels consist of several million words, with complicated structures and complex clues.
Some are really short with weak plots and one-dimensional characters.
Another reason is because some companies are too eager to earn money and therefore don’t care about the quality of the script.
Not even the best original fictions and famous actors will be able to make up for a poorly produced TV series.
